derive.name: hooks off: a fresh declared write is moving
hooks off: no write for T_fresh is stale, dimmed and never Running
hooks off: no write for T_retire is no signal, retired
open work with no evidence for T_history is left unfinished, counted once in Since you looked
left unfinished and seen moves to History
done: final card for T_done, passive
done after T_done leaves the Lock Screen, stays in Now until opened
done and opened: History only
failed: final card up to T_retire, active alert
failed past T_history: History only
dropped: ended at once, History only
paused: retired at once, Paused fold, left unfinished at T_history
pending question: Needs you, top card, time-sensitive
missed question: the work's own state, never Needs you (only a pending question asks)
pending question on a finished work still needs you
a late answer is stored; the work goes on by its own evidence
hooks: a permission prompt needs you
hooks: turn stopped, no write since: waiting on you, your turn until it reads as left open (5 min)
hooks: turn stopped 5+ min ago, round open: left open, Quiet and dimmed (session idle)
hooks: newest evidence observed within T_fresh/2 is working quietly
hooks: a running turn silent for T_fresh/2 stopped responding (never failed)
hooks: session ended with the work open: Quiet at once (session ended)
hooks: an ended session's card is a finished item: off the Lock Screen and Now after T_done, History only
hooks: session ended right after a write: Quiet at once, not moving
hooks: a fresh declared write wins over observed events (moving)
hooks: an open tool counts as working up to T_retire
declared --waiting keeps the card undimmed up to T_retire
script: a live lease keeps the work moving and extends staleDate
script without a lease: writes only
service: a fresh write is moving
service never shows observed states
hooks: a turn that stopped under a declared wait (a background job) is moving, not waiting on you
hooks: a declared wait past T_retire no longer outranks the idle session: no signal

sessions.name: hooks off: last seen from relo commands
working: a long turn kept current by heartbeats
waiting: the owner's turn counts from the stop, even when the session is seen again after it
a running turn silent for T_fresh/2 folds as idle
a stopped turn past T_fresh is idle and folded
waiting: a permission prompt up to T_history
opened, not prompted: hidden until its first prompt
hooks on: a quiet turn with a subagent or tool running is working up to T_retire
hooks on: a tool or subagent open past T_retire no longer holds it working
working: a stopped turn under a declared wait (a background job) up to T_retire
